## Spec review (W09E)
Mode: specification/initial; candidate ticket05-spec-r1 (r1); digest not recomputed (read-only toolset). 9 issues: HIGH 2, MEDIUM 6, LOW 1.

[F1][HIGH][statement-contradiction] spec:51; tools.go:1055-1062,1075-1080. C3 rebuilds only the decoded result; `payload.upstream_result` still derives from raw envelope bytes, and "left untouched and disclosed" licenses a partial projection — AC1 can pass while full upstream objects remain in structuredContent (R2/R6 fail; cf. 110237/50260). Fix: both delivery sites use one transformed result; assert over the whole marshaled payload.

[F2][HIGH][r-ac-coverage-gap] spec:11,69; bounded_delivery.go:58-83,164; config/bounds.go:365,375. Over-ceiling projections page to a metadata-only preview, dropping the disclosure (terminal path too); the over-ceiling oracle is full-opt-in only. Fix: disclosure in preview/page/terminal metadata + sizing/feasibility sets; add a default+paged oracle.

[F3][MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:73,49,124; E2/E3/E4. Only Id/Name/Type are evidenced; Status/GroupID (spelling unverified) are not, yet AC5 claims schema-derived defaults and T1's endpoint fixture is invented. Fix: narrow to Id/Name/Type or add observed payload evidence; restate AC5.

[F4][MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:71,74. `fields`+non-list: "unknown iff in no item" ⇒ AC3 rejection; AC6(d) requires skip/pass-through. Fix: shape check before field validation; add oracle.

[F5][MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:51,52,54,74. C4 fires on entry match incl. IsError vs AC6(a) "unchanged"; C3 cannot see the `select` that C6/T1 gate on; entry/reason undefined for non-allowlisted `full`. Fix: add upstreamSelectPresent; enumerate the decision table (error/full/select/no-match).

[F6][MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:55,72,111. Counter `tool` claimed allowlisted-only (2 values), but AC4/C5 reject non-allowlisted `fields`. Fix: define the rejection label (fixed literal or entryID) and cardinality.

[F7][MEDIUM][r-ac-coverage-gap] spec:13,50. R4's "1–16 unique" is advertised only; decodeStrict has no bounds check, `fields: []`/dupes project empty objects; no AC. Fix: explicit admission validation; T2 0/17/duplicate cases.

[F8][LOW][ledger-state-drift] spec:87,89,103,109. "2 new + 9 modified" vs actual 3+9; T3 "or NEW sibling" breaks the exact set; T2's one-record AC6 assertion needs T3 but deps={T1}; "every new assertion fails" is false for AC4 guards. Fix: correct counts, dependency, RED wording.

Open Questions (low confidence): spec:49 `Names[0]` on empty `Names`; `defaultFields` slice aliasing vs immutable claim; README disambiguation from session projections.

Positives: AC1–AC7 byte-equal to the ticket checkboxes; R1–R7 all AC-tagged. Corrections landed (T5→T4, no stale live ref; mandatory T3 `eventMessage` registration + render/non-violation test, log.go:90/282). Verified anchors: bounded_delivery.go:18/250, tools.go:879/1119/1328, schema.go:93, metrics.go:132 (=Metrics struct), log_test.go:69, bounds 8192. Allowlist identity feasible; paging reuse/ordering sound; Proxmox/OPNsense exclusion justified.

### Recommendation
REQUEST CHANGES
